label: Bible Study
prompt: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not _____.
verse: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
note: God's commandments aren't a burden — love makes them light.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging _____.
verse: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
note: David, now old, looks back: in a whole lifetime he never saw the righteous forsaken.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith Abel offered unto God a more _____ sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
verse: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
note: Abel's offering was 'more excellent' than Cain's — and Hebrews says Abel, though dead, still speaks.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that _____ souls is wise.
verse: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
note: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life — and wisdom shows in drawing others to it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or _____, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
verse: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
note: Christ's goal for his bride, the church: 'not having spot, or wrinkle' — no stain, no crease.
